items.name: Tarta de queso vasca de Matcha
items.notes: Name printed on two lines: "Tarta de queso" / "vasca de Matcha". Number 8003 is printed again for Dorayaki on this page (duplicate number in the source, same in carta2026/6.jpg).

items.name: Helados
items.description: Sabores: té matcha , judía roja y sésamo.
items.notes: Description printed with a space before the comma ("té matcha , judía roja"). No sesame icon is printed even though sésamo is listed as a flavour.

items.name: Dorayaki
items.notes: Printed as 8003, repeating the number of 'Tarta de queso vasca de Matcha' (probably meant to be 8005); kept as printed, identical in carta2026/6.jpg. Centred alone at the bottom of the page.

otherText: FUERA DE BUFFET (large red brush banner at the top of the page, applies to both sections)
